title: MLINE LTYPE XDATA code-1005 reference-count matrix, seventeen through thirty-two

scope.source: Runtime-generated DXF records; no repository drawing fixture was added.
scope.cross_product: Every count from seventeen through thirty-two was exercised across both source encodings and both output encodings.
scope.linetype: EditDash, two simple dash segments [1.0, -0.5], declared length 1.5, source flags 0, alignment 65.
scope.entity_providers: Each count uses the corresponding prefix of 32 unique generated source LINE handles (A900, A902–A920), each in ENTITIES and owned by model space. Distinct start-X coordinates identify expected targets, from 1.25 through 187.5.
scope.xdata_order: One group 1001 APPID name, one group 1000 string payload, followed by the exact count of ordered group 1005 soft-pointer handles.

documents.title: DXF Group Codes in Numerical Order Reference
documents.relevant_rule: Group 1005 is an entity handle in extended data, encoded as a hexadecimal string of up to 16 digits.

documents.title: Persistent Inter-Object Reference Handles (DXF)
documents.relevant_rule: XDATA group 1005 handles behave as soft pointers and translate when referenced objects are copied or inserted.

proof.source: For each count, generated physical XDATA order, typed import, source handles, APPID fields/owner, LINE identities and model-space ownership are checked. The source witness data is generated from scratch per count.
proof.output: For every count and ASCII/binary input/output pair, staged output verifies each group-1005 handle maps to its unique emitted LINE. Fresh typed readback checks exact ordered references, APPID and string payload, target identities and owner roles.
proof.failure_retry: For each count, the final target is removed under all four encoding pairs; export refuses and preserves the destination, then succeeds on the same adapter after the target is restored. A separate late handle mutation/refusal and corrected same-adapter retry is exercised for every count on ASCII input/output.

validation.asan: NOT_RUN; this slice changes runtime-generated test coverage only and does not modify production ownership, allocation, lifetime or parser behavior.

limits: This qualifies selected reference counts seventeen through thirty-two for one AC1027 simple-LTYPE XDATA composition targeting model-space LINEs. Counts thirty-three and above, other target types/sections, other XDATA compositions, versions and application meanings remain unqualified.
The evidence is selected transport and identity proof only; it does not establish complete recursive document closure, native MLINE rendering or broader format support.
next: Select a different current P2 witness. Continue reference counts thirty-three and above only when they are the next distinguishing, source-backed implementation witness; do not promote broader support claims from this matrix.
